title: Dont buy
text:
Dont buy. Queen pillow cases dont fit (too short) - fabric is thin - color not as nice as pics - and the elastic is so thin and whimpy - it wont last nor stay on corners. Returning.
Also - Cedar color has no blue - really look at pics or be disappointed.
